steps.instruction: Combine 4 tablespoons of sugar and 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon in a small bowl.
Heat 4 tablespoons of walnut oil in a frying pan.
Add 4 cubed slices of day-old French bread to the pan.
Fry the bread cubes, tossing to coat them with oil.
Spread the bread cubes on a baking sheet.
Sprinkle the cubes with the cinnamon sugar.
Bake for 8 minutes, until crispy and dry.
Let the croutons cool well before handling.
steps.spoken: Let the croutons cool well before you touch them. The sugar helps them brown, so they are hot at first.
